# Naksha

A design system drawn like a set of architectural sheets: paper and ink, square edges, hairline rules, mono sheet labels, and seven section hues that mark where you are. It comes straight from the live portfolio CSS, and it is built for product work: AI tools, fintech, legal and other information-heavy screens.

Source of truth: https://github.com/shreeraj301/naksha. Visual reference: the Naksha design system artifact on claude.ai.

## Rules

1. **Use a Naksha component for anything it covers.** Classes start with `nk-`; in React, import from `naksha`. The list is under Components in the Naksha skill and in the repo. Do not rebuild one from divs.
2. **Values come from tokens only.** Colours, space, sizes, type, motion: `var(--token-name)`. No hex, rgb() or named colours, and no px above 2 (Naksha's own lint rejects them; hold product code to the same rule). Pick a token by what it means, never because the colour happens to match.
3. **Overrides are layout only.** React components take `styles` for margin, width, flex or grid placement, position and z-index. Never colour, type, border or inner padding. If a look is missing, it needs a Naksha variant (ADR 0009).
4. **Paper and ink.** Square edges (`radius-control` and `radius-surface` are 0); hairlines (`border-default`), not shadows; only floating things get `shadow-overlay`. One `primary` button per region.
5. **Text contrast.** Body text is `fg-default`, secondary `fg-muted`. `fg-subtle` is for `bg-canvas` and `bg-raised` only, never `bg-subtle` (4.07:1). Status always pairs colour with an icon and words.
6. **Themes.** `data-theme="light"` or `"dark"` on `<html>`; with neither, `naksha.css` follows the OS. Never write theme-specific values in a product.
7. **India first.** Money and numbers with `Intl` and `en-IN` (₹1,25,000). Dates as 18 Dec 2026, caps in mono (18 DEC 2026), month cut to three letters ("Sept" becomes "Sep").
8. **AI surfaces.** People are round, agents are square and named. Facts carry numbered sources. While a reply streams, Send becomes Stop. Enter never sends while an input method is composing.
9. **Accessibility is the floor, not a feature.** WCAG 2.2 AA; visible focus on every stop; real buttons, links and labels; works in forced colours and with reduced motion.

## Setup

```html
<html data-theme="light">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/node_modules/naksha/dist/css/naksha.css">       <!-- or import "naksha/css" -->
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/node_modules/naksha/dist/css/components.css">   <!-- or import "naksha/css/components" -->
```

```js
import { color, space, cssVar } from "naksha/tokens";   // values for JS (px numbers)
import { layoutStyle } from "naksha";                     // React helpers and, from Phase 1, components
```

Naksha's CSS sits in cascade layers (`naksha.tokens`, `naksha.base`, `naksha.components`), so a product's own CSS outside a layer wins without `!important`.

## Colour (semantic tokens)

Light and dark value, with the primitive each aliases. Primitives (`stone-*`, hues, alpha) are never used directly.

| Token | Light | Dark | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bg-canvas` | #e8e4dc (stone-200) | #151413 (stone-950) | Page ground. Everything sits on paper (light) or ink (dark). |
| `bg-subtle` | #ddd8ce (stone-300) | #1c1b19 (stone-900) | Wells, table headers, modal footers, the user's chat block. |
| `bg-raised` | #f4f1eb (stone-50) | #24221f (stone-850) | Fields, menus, popovers and composers: anything you type into or that floats. |
| `bg-band` | #bdb7ac (stone-400) | #34312e (stone-800) | Skeletons, progress tracks, media placeholders. |
| `bg-inverse` | #151413 (stone-950) | #ece8e0 (stone-100) | Tooltips, toasts, the source number tile. |
| `bg-disabled` | #ddd8ce (stone-300) | #24221f (stone-850) | Fill of a disabled control. |
| `state-hover` | #15141314 (ink-a08) | #ece8e014 (paper-a08) | Layer over a transparent control on hover. |
| `state-pressed` | #15141329 (ink-a16) | #ece8e029 (paper-a16) | Layer on press, and for selected rows. |
| `fg-default` | #151413 (stone-950) | #ece8e0 (stone-100) | Body text, titles and icons on bg-canvas, bg-subtle and bg-raised. 14.5:1 light, 15:1 dark. |
| `fg-muted` | #57534d (stone-700) | #a7a196 (stone-500) | Secondary text on bg-canvas, bg-subtle and bg-raised. 5.4:1 or better in both themes. |
| `fg-subtle` | #6a655d (stone-600) | #a7a196 (stone-500) | Placeholders, sheet codes, separators. 4.56:1 on bg-canvas, 5.1:1 on bg-raised. Not on bg-subtle (4.07:1 in light): use fg-muted there. |
| `fg-disabled` | #a7a196 (stone-500) | #57534d (stone-700) | Text and icons of disabled controls only (exempt from contrast). |
| `fg-on-inverse` | #ece8e0 (stone-100) | #151413 (stone-950) | Text on bg-inverse and action-primary. |
| `fg-on-inverse-muted` | #a7a196 (stone-500) | #57534d (stone-700) | Secondary text on bg-inverse. 7.2:1 light, 6.3:1 dark. |
| `border-default` | #15141329 (ink-a16) | #ece8e029 (paper-a16) | Hairlines: dividers, card and table edges. Decorative, never the only edge of a control. |
| `border-strong` | #15141366 (ink-a40) | #ece8e066 (paper-a40) | Emphasised rules, table header rule, composer edge at rest. |
| `border-control` | #6a655d (stone-600) | #a7a196 (stone-500) | Edges of inputs, checkboxes, switches. 3:1 or better on every ground. |

## Type

| Class | Family | Size / line height / weight | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.display-hero` | display | 240px (fluid from 72px) / 0.8 / 800 | One per page: the name on the home sheet. Caps. Fluid 72px to 304px, the portfolio --t-mega clamp; 240px is the size shown in the artifact. |
| `.display-xl` | display | 100px (fluid from 40px) / 0.85 / 800 | Section openers. Caps. Fluid 40px to 100px, the portfolio --t-xl clamp. |
| `.display-l` | display | 52px (fluid from 28px) / 0.9 / 800 | Case-study titles, cover names. Caps. Fluid 28px to 52px, the portfolio --t-l clamp. |
| `.title-l` | sans | 40px (28px below 600px) / 1.1 / 600 | Product page titles. 40px, stepping to 28px below bp.medium (the portfolio has no clamp for this size). |
| `.title-m` | sans | 28px (fluid from 20px) / 1.15 / 600 | Modal titles, panel titles. Fluid 20px to 28px, the portfolio --t-m clamp. |
| `.title-s` | sans | 20px / 1.3 / 600 | Card titles, group headers. |
| `.body-l` | sans | 17px / 1.55 / 400 | Reading text and AI answers. Measure 64ch. |
| `.body-m` | sans | 15px / 1.5 / 400 | Default UI text. |
| `.body-s` | sans | 13px / 1.45 / 400 | Helper text, captions, meta. |
| `.label-m` | sans | 15px / 1.2 / 500 | Buttons, tabs, field labels (md and lg). |
| `.label-s` | sans | 13px / 1.2 / 500 | Small buttons, field labels (sm), menu shortcuts. |
| `.mono-label` | mono | 12px / 1.3 / 400 | Sheet codes, tags, column heads, breadcrumbs. Caps, tracked +4% so small capitals stay legible. |
| `.mono-data` | mono | 13px / 1.45 / 400 | Numbers, amounts, dates, counters, code. Tabular figures. |
| `.serif-quote` | serif | 28px / 1.25 / 400 | Pull quotes and poetry (the Pause section). |
| `.serif-body` | serif | 19px / 1.55 / 400 | Essays. Measure 60ch. |

## Space, size, motion

- Space: `space-0` 0px, `space-2` 2px, `space-4` 4px, `space-6` 6px, `space-8` 8px, `space-12` 12px, `space-16` 16px, `space-20` 20px, `space-24` 24px, `space-32` 32px, `space-40` 40px, `space-48` 48px, `space-64` 64px, `space-80` 80px, `space-96` 96px, `space-128` 128px
- Size: `size-control-sm` 32px, `size-control-md` 40px, `size-control-lg` 48px, `size-control-touch-sm` 36px, `size-control-touch-md` 44px, `size-control-touch-lg` 52px, `size-icon-sm` 16px, `size-icon-md` 20px, `size-icon-lg` 24px, `size-measure` 64ch
- Radius: `radius-2` 2px, `radius-4` 4px, `radius-8` 8px, `radius-control` 0px, `radius-surface` 0px, `radius-round` 9999px
- Layout: `layout-columns` 12, `layout-gutter` 40px, `layout-unit` 16px, `layout-section` 128px, `layout-nav-height` 64px
- Breakpoints (min-width): `bp-medium` 600px, `bp-expanded` 900px, `bp-large` 1200px, `bp-xlarge` 1440px
- Duration: `dur-press` 140ms, `dur-hover` 150ms, `dur-ui` 200ms, `dur-overlay` 280ms, `dur-page` 450ms, `dur-hero` 900ms
- Easing: `ease-out` cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), `ease-settle` cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), `ease-in-out` cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1)

## Components

| Component | What it is for |
| --- | --- |
| [Accordion](references/components/Accordion.md) | Progressive disclosure for FAQs and dense specs. |
| [Alert](references/components/Alert.md) | An inline message tied to a page or section. Icon plus words, never colour alone. |
| [Avatar](references/components/Avatar.md) | A person or an agent, at 24, 32, 40 or 48. |
| [Breadcrumb](references/components/Breadcrumb.md) | Where you are in the sheet set, in `mono-label` caps like the portfolio's sheet labels. |
| [Button](references/components/Button.md) | Buttons start an action. One `primary` per region; everything else is `secondary` or `ghost`. |
| [Card](references/components/Card.md) | A sheet in the set: media, sheet code, title, one line, one link. |
| [ChatMessage](references/components/ChatMessage.md) | One turn in a conversation with an AI. |
| [Checkbox](references/components/Checkbox.md) | An independent on or off choice, or "select all" with the indeterminate state. |
| [Divider](references/components/Divider.md) | Hairline rules between content, like the lines between sheets on the portfolio. |
| [DropdownMenu](references/components/DropdownMenu.md) | A floating list of actions from a trigger (a ghost IconButton with `ellipsis`, or a Select). |
| [EmptyState](references/components/EmptyState.md) | What a view shows before it has data: what will appear here, and one way to start. |
| [IconButton](references/components/IconButton.md) | A square button that holds one icon, for frequent actions in toolbars, cards and composers. |
| [Input](references/components/Input.md) | A single-line text field with a visible label above it and helper or error text below. |
| [Kbd](references/components/Kbd.md) | A keyboard key. Use `<kbd>`, one per key, in `mono-label` sizing without caps transform. |
| [Link](references/components/Link.md) | Text that takes you somewhere. Underlined at rest so links never rely on colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1). |
| [Modal](references/components/Modal.md) | Blocks the page for one decision that needs full attention. |
| [ProgressBar](references/components/ProgressBar.md) | Progress for tasks longer than about two seconds. 4px `bg-band` track, `fg-default` fill, label and `mono-data` value above. |
| [PromptInput](references/components/PromptInput.md) | The composer for talking to an AI like garu. |
| [Radio](references/components/Radio.md) | One choice from a short, visible list. |
| [SegmentedControl](references/components/SegmentedControl.md) | Switch between two to four views or modes with every option visible, like the portfolio's Human / Agent toggle. |
| [Select](references/components/Select.md) | Pick one option from five or more. For two to four options use SegmentedControl or Radio so every choice stays visible. |
| [Skeleton](references/components/Skeleton.md) | A placeholder in the shape of the content that is loading, so nothing shifts when it arrives. |
| [SourceChip](references/components/SourceChip.md) | Ties an AI claim to where it came from: a clause, a page, a URL. |
| [Spinner](references/components/Spinner.md) | An indeterminate wait inside a control or a small area. A quarter arc in `currentColor` over a `border-default` ring, one turn every 900ms, linear (a faster spin reads as a faster app). |
| [SuggestionChip](references/components/SuggestionChip.md) | A prompt starter, written the way the person would ask. |
| [Switch](references/components/Switch.md) | Turns a setting on or off immediately, with no Save button. |
| [Table](references/components/Table.md) | Dense, scannable rows (Found It subscriptions, Ledger statements). |
| [Tabs](references/components/Tabs.md) | Switch between sibling views of the same thing (Overview / Research / Process). |
| [Tag](references/components/Tag.md) | One to three words of status or category: "Start here", "Live", "Draft", "Due". |
| [Textarea](references/components/Textarea.md) | A multi-line field for long input, with an optional live character counter. |
| [Toast](references/components/Toast.md) | A short confirmation after an action: "Copied", "Saved", "Subscription cancelled". |
| [Tooltip](references/components/Tooltip.md) | Names an icon-only control or shows its shortcut. Never holds anything a person needs to finish a task. |
| [TopNav](references/components/TopNav.md) | The site header from the portfolio: identity left, sectioned nav in the middle, Human / Agent mode right. |

The brand book (voice, colour, type, layout, motion, iconography, AI patterns, accessibility): [references/brand-book.md](references/brand-book.md).

## Reviewing UI built with Naksha

Every finding cites evidence: a file and line, a rendered state (theme, width, forced colours, reduced motion), or a source. Mark each area **good**, **needs work** or **not inspected**. Missing evidence is "not inspected", never a pass.

Check, in this order: the right component is used; tokens only (no raw values); layout-only overrides; both themes; keyboard path and visible focus; forced colours; reduced motion; empty, loading, error and long-content states; narrow and wide widths; Indian formats.
